message: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: Expected values to be strictly equal: false !== true at repair.mjs:283:14
precedingActualSvgChecksPassed: Every label at least 16px and inside media
diagnosis: The helper compares outerHTML strings from a live HTML SVG DOM with an XML DOMParser document; their serialization conventions differ. That string comparison is not an attribute-level geometric comparison.
technicalRecovery: Compare element local names and sorted structured attributes, then rerun only offline display verification using the unchanged native-pass SVG. Keep geometry and original-label checks strict; do not revalidate or rerender.
